disagreements: Research remains intentionally blocked before route generation. Set A now has direct Japanese coverage of the complete chronological playthrough plus all 14 bonus-scenario triggers/timing. Set B independently corroborates the mandatory battle order and broad ending/NG+ mechanics, but the directly inspectable Japanese Set B gathered so far still does not independently enumerate all 14 bonus-scenario triggers and their missable timing. The detailed FFSKY walkthrough agrees with those triggers but is Chinese and therefore supplemental only. Do not generate route_*.json until a second directly inspectable Japanese source closes that remaining 100%-critical optional-content gap.
